q: How does an Ariyalur cement plant's mix of coal, pet coke and lignite change its CO2 per tonne of clinker?
title: Ariyalur cement: fuel mix and CO2
short: Calcination CO2 stays about the same, roughly half a tonne per tonne of clinker. Fuel CO2 depends on heat per tonne and the fuel's factor: IPCC defaults are about 94.6 kg CO2 per GJ for bituminous coal, 97.5 for pet coke and 101 for lignite.
audience: Cement plants in Ariyalur and Tamil Nadu, and their buyers

ol: Heat per tonne of clinker, in GJ, from kiln fuel and output.
Share of heat from each fuel.
Add calcination from clinker CaO and MgO.

p: Alternative fuels such as biomass or plastic waste, a lower heat rate, and less clinker per tonne of cement.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each figure shows the quantity, factor and document it came from.
